## ARC Update

Use this template for any change that does not add a new ARC or change its status:
adoption or implementation updates, and editorial or non-normative changes.

## Summary

Describe the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] Every new adoption entry links public, verifiable evidence.
- [ ] Any ARC text change is non-normative and does not change ARC intent or requirements.

## Notes for Reviewers

Call out anything that might be mistaken for a normative change, or new adoption evidence.
